name: Factorized Radiance Field with Fixed View-Dependent Components
definition: A radiance field representation that models geometry and appearance grids as factorized tensors, where the number of components is fixed to the number of input views (n), unlike TensoRF which uses a fixed small number of components.
summary: Factorized Radiance Field with Fixed View-Dependent Components reconstructs radiance fields by binding tensor components to specific input views, enabling robust point cloud fusion that substitutes inaccurate depth-derived points with accurate ones from other views.
